mapper.select: SELECT bs.branch_stock_id AS branchStockId, bs.branch_stock_code AS branchStockCode, m.material_name AS materialName, bs.expire_date AS expireDate, bs.current_qty AS currentQty, m.unit AS unit FROM branch_stock bs JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.current_qty > 0 AND bs.expire_date < CURDATE()

SELECT bs.branch_stock_id AS branchStockId, bs.branch_stock_code AS branchStockCode, m.material_name AS materialName, bs.expire_date AS expireDate, bs.current_qty AS currentQty, m.unit AS unit FROM branch_stock bs JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.current_qty > 0 AND bs.expire_date = CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY

SELECT bs.branch_stock_id AS branchStockId, bs.branch_stock_code AS branchStockCode, m.material_name AS materialName, bs.expire_date AS expireDate, bs.current_qty AS currentQty, m.unit AS unit FROM branch_stock bs JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.current_qty > 0 AND bs.expire_date > CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND bs.expire_date <= CURDATE() + INTERVAL 3 DAY

SELECT bs.branch_stock_id AS branchStockId, bs.branch_stock_code AS branchStockCode, m.material_name AS materialName, bs.expire_date AS expireDate, bs.current_qty AS currentQty, m.unit AS unit FROM branch_stock bs JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.current_qty = 0

SELECT bs.branch_stock_id AS branchStockId, bs.branch_stock_code AS branchStockCode, m.material_name AS materialName, bs.expire_date AS expireDate, bs.current_qty AS currentQty, ss.safe_stock_qty AS safeStockQty, m.unit AS unit FROM branch_stock bs JOIN material m ON bs.material_code = m.material_code JOIN branch_material_safety_stock ss ON ss.branch_code = bs.branch_code AND ss.material_code = bs.material_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bs.current_qty > 0 AND ss.safe_stock_qty > 0 AND bs.current_qty < ss.safe_stock_qty
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (category, title, message, target_type, target_id, created_at) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{message}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, NOW())
